about-us.description:
The Al-Tai Club Store is the official online shop that brings together the club’s fans and its products in one place, offering a complete shopping experience that reflects the club’s identity and rich history.
The store provides a wide range of official Al-Tai Club merchandise, including sportswear, accessories, and specially designed memorabilia for fans. All products are carefully selected to ensure high quality and designs that express the spirit of Al-Tai Club and the loyalty of its supporters.
At the Al-Tai Club Store, we aim to strengthen the connection between fans and their club by offering services and products that meet their expectations and give them the opportunity to express their pride and loyalty, both within the Kingdom and abroad.

privacyAndTerms.description:
At Al-Tai Club Store, we place great importance on the privacy of our users and are committed to protecting the personal data collected when using the website or benefiting from the store’s services.
This policy explains how users’ personal data is collected, used, and processed when visiting the website or placing orders through it.
Please read the privacy policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal information and your related rights.

how.title: How to Subscribe
how.description: Choose a monthly plan, create your account, and complete payment to get instant access. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime.

step1.title: Register & Choose Your Tier
step1.description: You can subscribe to any tier upon registration or later via the Memberships page on the website or app.

step2.title: Complete Payment Easily
step2.description: Selecting a membership and confirming your subscription is easy through the available payment methods.

step3.title: Start Enjoying Benefits Instantly
step3.description: Once subscribed, your membership is activated instantly and you begin enjoying all the benefits of your chosen tier.

conditions.title: Membership Terms and Conditions
conditions.item1: Memberships are annual and renew automatically unless cancelled before the end of the year.
conditions.item2: Benefits vary by membership tier and will be detailed when selecting a membership.
conditions.item3: The store reserves the right to modify membership terms or benefits, with prior notice to members via email or the app.
